games.title: Blobby Pop
games.tagline: Match the blobs. Pop the blobs. Love the blobs.

description.short: A squishy match-3 where every blob has feelings. Chain pops, trigger jelly bombs and clear 300+ wobbly levels.
long: Blobby Pop is a match-3 puzzle game with a squishy twist: every blob wobbles, giggles and bounces when you touch it. Swipe to match three or more, chain reactions to fill the Jelly Meter, then unleash a giant Jelly Bomb.
Each world adds a new kind of blob, from sticky Gum Blobs to shy Ghost Blobs that only appear when you're not looking. Learn it in one tap, and master it over hundreds of levels.

features: Play offline, with no timers or energy walls

reviews.author: @jellyqueen
reviews.quote: I meant to play one level. It is now 2am. Send help (and more blobs).
The squishiest puzzle game on your phone. Every pop feels like bubble wrap for your brain.

reviews.author: @popmaster3000
reviews.quote: Ghost Blobs are pure evil and I love them.

seo.title: Blobby Pop: the squishiest match-3 puzzle game
seo.description: Match, pop and wobble through 300+ levels in Blobby Pop, a free squishy puzzle game for iOS and Android by FewClicks.

games.title: Rocket Tap
games.tagline: One tap. One rocket. Infinite space.

description.short: Tap to boost, release to drift. Thread your rocket through asteroid rings and chase the high score.
long: Rocket Tap is a one-button arcade game built for the few seconds between everything else. Hold to boost, let go to glide, and slip through glowing rings while dodging asteroids.
Collect stardust to unlock 40+ ridiculous rockets, including a flying toaster, a disco ball and a very confused whale. Compete with friends on daily leaderboards.

features: One-button controls anyone can learn instantly

reviews.author: @spacecadet
reviews.quote: Simple, fast and impossible to put down. The whale rocket is my son now.
A perfect one-more-go game with buttery smooth controls.

seo.title: Rocket Tap: one-tap space arcade game
seo.description: Boost, drift and dodge asteroids in Rocket Tap, a free one-button arcade game for iOS, Android and web by FewClicks.

games.title: Slime Tower
games.tagline: Stack the slimes. Don't let them slide.

description.short: A wobbly stacking game where gravity is your frenemy. Drop slimes, balance the tower and reach the clouds.
long: Slime Tower is a physics stacking game with a gooey heart. Tap to drop a slime and watch it squish, wobble and (hopefully) settle on the tower below.
Different slimes behave differently: Sticky slimes grab their neighbours, Bouncy slimes have opinions, and Golden slimes are worth the risk.

features: Relaxing zen mode with no game over

reviews.author: @stackattack
reviews.quote: The most satisfying squish sound ever recorded.

reviews.author: @goo_enthusiast
reviews.quote: Zen mode is my new bedtime routine.

seo.title: Slime Tower: squishy physics stacking game
seo.description: Stack wobbly slimes to the clouds in Slime Tower, a relaxing physics stacking game for iOS and Android by FewClicks.

games.title: Dungeon Dice Dash
games.tagline: Roll the dice. Raid the dungeon. Run for your life.

description.short: A fast roguelite where every attack is a dice roll. Build a cursed dice bag, dash through rooms and out-luck the dungeon.
long: Dungeon Dice Dash is an action roguelite where your weapons are dice. Roll for attacks, dodges and spells, then customise your dice faces with runes found deep in the dungeon.
Every run reshuffles the rooms, the enemies and your luck. Team up with a friend in local co-op and argue about who rolled the ones.

features: 150+ runes to craft wild dice combos
Local co-op for two dungeon divers
Hand-drawn dungeons with a 90s cartoon vibe

reviews.quote: The best fight we've had over a dice roll since board game night. A co-op gem.

reviews.author: @critfail
reviews.quote: Rolled six ones in a row and still won. 10/10 would gamble again.

seo.title: Dungeon Dice Dash: dice-building action roguelite
seo.description: Roll dice, build runes and raid dungeons in Dungeon Dice Dash, an action roguelite with local co-op for PC (Steam) and Nintendo Switch.

games.title: Paper Plane Party

description.short: A party game where you fold your own paper plane and race friends through a giant messy house.
long: Paper Plane Party lets you fold, doodle and launch your own paper plane, then race up to 8 friends through kitchens, attics and the dreaded laundry room.
We're still folding this one. Follow our devlog for behind-the-scenes updates!

features: Design and doodle your own plane
Up to 8 players, online or on one couch

seo.title: Paper Plane Party: multiplayer paper plane racing
seo.description: Fold, doodle and race paper planes with up to 8 friends. Paper Plane Party is in development at FewClicks.

games.title: Neon Drift Club
games.tagline: Drift after dark. Light up the city.

description.short: An arcade drift racer where your tyres paint the city in neon. Drift long, glow bright, win the night.
long: Neon Drift Club is a pick-up-and-play arcade racer. Every drift leaves a trail of light, and the longer you slide, the more of the city you paint.
Race friends in 4-player split screen, customise your ride with glowing decals and climb the club rankings from Rookie to Neon Legend.

features: Drift to paint the city with light
Easy to drive, wild to master

seo.title: Neon Drift Club: arcade drift racing (coming soon)
seo.description: Drift after dark and paint the city in neon. Neon Drift Club is coming to PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch.
